description: This file defines the UI for the Android TV home screen using Jetpack Compose. It includes composable functions for rendering the top navigation bar, section rows with carousels of content items, and individual content cards with focus handling and animations. The functions manage layout, focus states, animations, and display of content data models.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Data model representing a section containing a list of ContentItem objects with a title.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Data model representing individual content with properties like title, poster resource, and progress.

methods.name: HomeRoot
methods.description: Main composable rendering the home screen with navigation and content sections.

methods.name: TopNavBar
methods.description: Composes the top navigation bar with scrollable list of items.

methods.name: NavPill
methods.description: Renders a selectable pill button with focus animations and background styling.

methods.name: SectionRow
methods.description: Displays a section header and horizontally scrollable content cards.

methods.name: HorizontalCards
methods.description: Displays a horizontal scrolling row of content cards.

methods.name: ContentCard
methods.description: Displays individual content with focus animations, poster image, title, and optional progress bar.

methods.name: ProgressBar
methods.description: Shows a progress bar indicating content progress.
